estimation_procedure.description: Equation (1) is pooled over all years relevant to the IAS-versus-matched-NIAS post-adoption comparison. Its residuals are pooled by IAS/NIAS group to compute the variance of AM*. Differences in metrics are assessed using the empirical-distribution J-test: observations are assigned to comparison groups by resampling with replacement, repeated 1,000 times.

evidence.quote: For example, when comparing IAS and NIAS firms in the postadoption period, we pool all sample years in the postadoption period.
For this comparison, the variability of AM* is the variance of the IAS and NIAS firms' respective residuals from equation (1) in the postadoption period.

With the exception of the tests for the frequency of small positive and
large negative net income, for which we test for significance of regression
coefficients, we test for differences in each metric using a J-testbased on
the empirical distribution of the differences.

We obtain
the empirical distribution of this difference by repeating this procedure
1,000 times.
